sectors.name: Technology
themes: US semiconductor capex cycle, led by memory and AI chips, will drive demand for Indonesia's downstream electronics assembly and data center buildout over 12-18 months.

sectors.ai: Indonesia's tech sector lags US peers but shows structural upside; overweight NBIS for AI-driven data center demand and ALAB for cloud migration, as US semis strength signals global capex cycle acceleration that will eventually lift ID-listed tech hardware and digital infrastructure plays.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's nickel downstreaming policy creates a durable competitive advantage for domestic battery and energy storage supply chains, insulating local players from global price swings.
Geothermal development remains a structural growth driver, supported by government targets to increase capacity by 3.5 GW by 2030 and favorable feed-in tariffs.
The revision of the National Energy Plan (RUEN) is expected to mandate higher renewable energy mix targets, directly benefiting solar and wind project developers and local equipment manufacturers.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables sector shows strong momentum, with PLUG and NRG leading gains. Watch for policy catalysts from the upcoming national energy plan revision and potential tariff adjustments for solar and battery storage. Focus on local manufacturing plays tied to nickel downstreaming and geothermal expansion, as these offer direct exposure to Indonesia's structural energy transition without relying on volatile global clean-tech sentiment.

sectors.ai: Buy ESTI and AGAR on strong volume breakouts; trim US-exposed names like WMPP as ID consumer rotation accelerates. Favor domestic staples with pricing power and digital distribution tailwinds.

Medical tourism expansion, targeting 5 million foreign patients by 2025, boosts premium hospital chains and specialized care providers in Jakarta and Bali.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's healthcare sector shows relative strength (+0.72%) versus US weakness, signaling domestic resilience. Key movers like SRAJ and MICE indicate local demand momentum. Capitalize on this divergence by overweighting Indonesian hospital and pharma names, as structural underpenetration and rising medical tourism drive durable growth.
